To state what I am saying above in a different way:  The point of a VPN is to mask your IP address.  All traffic flowing to you flows to the VPN's IP and is then forwarded to you.  The server sending you data doesn't know where you are in that case. It knows the IP address from which the request was made and that is where it delivers the data.  The geo mapping shows the location of the VPN IP, not your physical location.  I have tested this many times and watched how it was mapped.  .... Open to learn differently though! (edited)
